insurer: Universal Sompo General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy covers room, boarding and nursing expenses as per hospital but no explicit room rent cap or category mentioned in wording

icu.note: ICU charges defined and covered but no explicit cap or sub-limit stated

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies on each and every claim for insured persons above 55 years of age

sub_limits.display: Maternity 5% of SI; package charges 75% of SI
sub_limits.note: Maternity capped at 5% of SI; hospitalization under package charges capped at 75% of SI; specific disease waiting list is extensive

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required; reducible via portability credits

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, piles, joint replacement, stones, etc.

maternity.display: Covered (9mo wait), up to 5% of SI
maternity.note: Maternity expenses covered after 9 months from policy inception; capped at 5% of sum insured; newborn treatment also covered within this limit

cumulative_bonus.note: No traditional cumulative bonus on SI mentioned; only health check-up reimbursement up to 1% of average SI after 3 claim-free policy years

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement benefit mentioned in policy wording

day_care.note: Specific day-care procedures listed including dialysis, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, eye surgery, lithotripsy, D&C, tonsillectomy; also covers procedures requiring less than 24 hrs due to technological advances

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalization covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered; AYUSH hospital and day care centre definitions included in policy

organ_donor.note: Cost of organ harvesting explicitly listed as a covered medical expense

ambulance.note: Road ambulance charges limited to Rs. 1,000 per policy period per admissible claim

modern_treatments.note: No explicit mention of modern/robotic treatments coverage or sub-limits in policy wording

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables explicitly excluded (Annexure A); gloves, masks, etc. not payable

global_cover.note: Treatment outside geographical limits of India is a specific exclusion

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; portability/migration credits count

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual modes

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for policies of 1 year or more

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, adventure sports injuries, OPD not covered, no global cover, consumables excluded, package charges capped at 75% SI

optional_riders.note: PA death cover pays 100% SI for account holder, 50% for spouse, 20%/10% for children on accidental death
